notes: The appositional even is left added under rule 16's limit, since no object marker stands on אֲנַחְנוּ; the alternative reading gives even us to the pronoun.
The copula are is placed on חַיִּים as the clause's predicate rather than on כֻּלָּנוּ (rule 20).
כֹּל takes only all and the suffix takes of us, headed on the pronoun, exactly as rule 19 directs for כֻּלָּם.
